extracted.name: Baked Tomato Slices
extracted.description: Baked tomato slices seasoned with rosemary and garlic make colorful and tasty pizza toppers.
ingredient_lines: 1 sprig fresh rosemary, leaves stripped and finely chopped
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Brush a baking sheet with about 1 tablespoon olive oil.
Arrange tomato slices on the baking sheet; sprinkle rosemary and garlic on top. Brush with remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil; season with salt and pepper.
Bake in the preheated oven until tender, 5 to 10 minutes.
